title: Name levels by bordercall
summary: Names each vertebra counting from C2 with no network: the count, the ribs and VERIDAH kept apart.
does: bordercall's own commands over a label tree counted from C2 (tools/bordercall_corpus.py, grid/bordercall.sbatch): a column without C2 is set aside, a gap rule catches a missed body, and three namings are kept and never pooled, the count, the ribs and VERIDAH's. Only the lumbar measurements are validated. Today the word runs it over the census's existing SPINEPS masks, a pilot and then the full corpus (8 CPUs, 32 GB, 12 h). Naming from a morphometry table's rows, the features step of the latent prior evaluation, has no word yet.

inputs.name: data
inputs.what: Masks counted from C2, or (planned) a morphometry table.

outputs.name: names
outputs.what: Each column's naming, with counts that leave the grid.

params.name: stage
params.what: the word's stage: the pilot first

generic.why: It counts vertebrae in 3-D masks, or, planned, reads a table of their measurements; a 2-D frame shows no column to count from C2.

today.note: then bordercall full; bordercall complete is the gold tier 3 completion
